title: Two-way Analysis of Variance Summary — summary2way
text: fit lm object, .e. output lm(). page options output: "table", "means", "effects", "interaction", "nointeraction". digits number decimal places display. conf.level confidence level intervals. print.TRUE, print output screen. new TRUE run new version summary2way robust old version. However, work way. particular, page = 'means' return summary statistics grouping data (pooled, row factor, column factor, interaction factor). FUN optional function applied estimates confidence intervals. Typically backtransformation operations. ... arguments inttype pooled.

title: Two-way Analysis of Variance Summary — summary2way
text: `summary2way()` prints requested teaching summary page     invisibly returns current summary components. returned list     following components: Df degrees     freedom regression, residual total. Sum     Sq sum squares regression, residual total. Mean     Sq mean squares regression residual. F     value F-statistic value. Pr(F) P-value associated     F-test. Grand Mean overall mean     response variable. Row Effects main effects     first (row) factor. Col Effects main effects     second (column) factor. Interaction Effects     interaction effects interaction model fitted,     otherwise NULL. results new = TRUE,     list five components: table -     ANOVA table, means table means     model.tables, effects - table effects     model.tables, comparisons - differences     means standard errors, confidence bounds,     P-values TukeyHSD .

title: Two-way Analysis of Variance Summary — summary2way
